claim_boundary: This is a pre-registered curated-development cohort for testing generic persistent-theory revision. Selection categories originate in offline-only audit material and are never live controller inputs. The cohort is not the frozen 25+25 generalization denominator and cannot support an ARC1 or ARC2 solver claim.
selection_protocol: Five ARC1 and five ARC2 tasks were selected before P0007 from the offline-only feature audit for conditional or multi-rule structure. The task list is immutable for P0007; no post-run substitutions are permitted.
title: Pre-registered ARC12 conditional/multi-rule revision cohort
